description: Formant oscillator — four formants over one fundamental, which makes vowel sounds

params.text: Sets the fundamental pitch in semitones, 0 giving C4 at 261.63Hz
Steps through eight stored settings of the eight formant controls, each one a French vowel
Sets the centre frequency of that formant; the four cover 190Hz to 730Hz, 800Hz to 2100Hz, 1500Hz to 3100Hz and 3000Hz to 4700Hz from the lowest to the highest
Sets how strong that formant is in the sound

inputs.text: Pitch at a volt per octave, added to the pitch knob
0V to 10V sweeps that formant across its whole frequency range, added to the knob
0V to 10V adds to that formant's strength across its whole range

outputs.text: The oscillator's output, with all four formants in it

notes: the model puts a constant offset into the output at high frequencies, so it is best kept low and mid

inputs.1: 1V per octave · continuous · one channel only
